sections.title: Context and goals
sections.content: A client calls GET /health and receives status ok.
sections.rationale: Small stateless component meets accepted requirements.

sections.title: Boundaries and contracts
sections.content: AS-IS: empty app. TARGET: GET /health returns HTTP 200 with application/json and status ok. KNOWN DEVIATION: implementation pending. Errors use HTTP 500 without retries.

sections.title: Deployment and testing
sections.content: One Node.js service behind gateway. Rollback to previous release. Local and CI use the same validation contract.
